text: I've been using the full version since months. I like that it offers not just categories but also lists, helping me manage different areas of life separately. After trying many apps, I found its habit tracker and task repetition features the most customizable. (For example, you can set any number as a priority, not just 1-2-3, and track habits at custom intervals, not just daily.) The settings can be simple or highly specific if needed. (I don’t miss any features—but maybe more skins/themes? :))
